name: Auntie Efe's Pot
description: A soup and stew vendor operating from a converted utility closet in a Milwaukee the Gray Zone residential tower. Efe Lindqvist-Amadi cooks West African-inspired stews using whatever protein is cheapest that week — usually vat-chicken, sometimes synth-goat, once memorably something she refused to identify but everyone agreed was excellent. A bowl with fufu is Φ5, which is expensive by the Gray Zone standards but worth it because Auntie Efe's cooking is the kind that makes you forget where you are for the duration of the meal. She feeds corridor kids for free and considers this non-negotiable.
